Up to 9 in 10 boys go through this, and almost nobody explains it 🛏️

Wet dreams (nocturnal emissions) start in puberty, when testosterone rises and the body starts making millions of sperm a day. They often begin around 12 or 13, you can't control them, and they get less common with age. Some people never have one, and girls can have them too.

It's not a health problem. Wash the sheets, move on.

Sources: Cleveland Clinic, KidsHealth, FPA.
